setup_speech_to_text_task: setup a SpeechToTextTask instance by loading the target dictionary from the manifest data path
load_speech_to_text_dataset: load a speech to text dataset split from TSV files using SpeechToTextDatasetCreator
build_s2t_criterion: build a criterion for speech to text training with language tag prefix validation
build_s2t_generator: build a sequence generator for speech to text inference with language token stripping
build_s2t_model: build a speech to text model with audio input feature and channel configuration
